action.name: Paste Clipboard Image
action.command: sh -c 'DIR="$1"; [ -d "$DIR" ] || DIR="$(dirname "$DIR")"; TIMESTAMP=$(date +%%Y%%m%%d_%%H%%M%%S); TARGETS=$(xclip -selection clipboard -t TARGETS -o 2>/dev/null); if echo "$TARGETS" | grep -q "image/png"; then xclip -selection clipboard -t image/png -o > "$DIR/screenshot_${TIMESTAMP}.png" && notify-send "Thunar" "Pasted screenshot_${TIMESTAMP}.png"; else notify-send -u critical "Thunar" "No image found in clipboard!"; fi' _ %f
action.description: Save image from clipboard into current folder

action.name: Copy Absolute Path
action.command: copyq add "%F" && copyq select 0 && notify-send "Thunar" "Copied to CopyQ: %F"
action.description: Copy absolute path of selected files/folders to clipboard
